title: 中国早餐宇宙②武汉热干面：一壶打翻的油，成就一座城的早饭 | Wuhan Hot-Dry Noodles 🍜
description:
你的早餐，能拌出这样一碗吗？评论区聊聊。

【中国早餐宇宙·第2集 武汉】相传上世纪三十年代，汉口一个卖面的摊贩把剩面煮熟晾着，不小心打翻油壶，油全洒在面上，只好拌匀继续晾干——第二天一烫，竟香气四溢，热干面就这么来了。真正的灵魂是那勺浓稠芝麻酱：大约 1937 年，蔡明纬往面里加了胡椒、萝卜丁和厚芝麻酱，做出又香又顶饿的一碗。抗战胜利后他和弟弟蔡明经在满春路口老楝树下开店，「双木成林」取名蔡林记。武汉人管吃早餐叫「过早」，热干面就是过早桌上的头牌。拌面讲究深翻浅覆、高挑低搅，让每根面都裹上酱。

Legend says hot-dry noodles were born from an accident: a 1930s Hankou vendor knocked over an oil jug onto his leftover noodles, tossed and dried them — and reheated the next day, they smelled amazing. The soul is thick sesame paste: around 1937, Cai Mingwei added pepper, pickled radish and rich sesame paste. After WWII he and his brother opened a shop under old trees, naming it "Cai Lin Ji" — two trees making a forest. In Wuhan, breakfast is called "guò zǎo," and this bowl is its star.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Food folklore, not dietary advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
